projects.text: A selection of my work: full-stack apps, frontend & UI design. I focus on building clean, fast, and user-friendly experiences. Most of these were freelance projects, others were built for fun or learning. Also working on my own projects at the same time.

skillset.text: I study cybersecurity and computer science. My interests include web development, ethical security research, OSINT, and software development.

frontend.description: I explore how to build responsive and accessible websites with clear interfaces and thoughtful user experiences.

backend.description: I am learning how software systems and backend services are designed and how they work together.

environment.description: I am interested in ethical security research and OSINT, and in learning responsible ways to investigate digital systems.

me.text: I’d describe myself as a cheerful and optimistic person with tons of ideas and plans in different areas. I’m still in school and constantly working on self-improvement. My main goal is to make the web a better and more beautiful place. Outside of programming, I like experimenting with drawing.
